title: Known-object test, TOI-1351.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-1351.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* ≤2.5, 3, 4, 3.5, ≤2.5, 3.5; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth 2%, 2%, 2%, 2%, 2%, 2% (completeness for 2000 ppm: 10%, 0%, 0%, 0%, 0%, 10%). The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit recovered (1 covered epoch). Residual screen: 342 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 6 light curve(s), forming 60 distinct event(s), 38 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines. Repeat candidate: a persistent event matching the catalogued depth at BJD 2460636.7790 (ΔT 17.79 d); 0 period aliases remain. Unverified lead until vetted.
